entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION (AGAINST CONVICTION - FOOD  ADULTRATION ACT) NO. 949 of 2016
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: MR YM THAKKAR, ADVOCATE for the Applicant  MR NJ SHAH ADDL. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent No. 2

===
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE Z.K.SAIYED  Date : 02/12/2016  ORAL ORDER
[1] RULE. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.

[2] In the present Criminal Revision Application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the sentence imposed by judgment and order dated 20.12.2012 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Visavadar in Criminal Case No.58 of 2008 as well as the judgment and order dated 30.11.2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Junagadh in Criminal Appeal No.110 of 2012 rejecting the appeal filed by the present applicant and confirmed the order passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Visavadar, by which, the applicant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 7(l) and 7(v) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of one year with fine of Rs.10,000/- and in default, to undergo further period of one month simple imprisonment.
[3] Heard learned advocate appearing for the applicant and HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Sat Dec 03 00:20:02 IST 2016 R/CR.RA/949/2016 ORDER learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.

sentences.text: [4] Learned advocate for the applicant submits that the applicant is a young man at the relevant time and now, he is in jail.
He, therefore, prays to release the applicant on bail on suitable terms and conditions.

[5] Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the sentence imposed by judgment and order dated 20.12.2012 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Visavadar in Criminal Case No.58 of 2008 as well as the judgment and order dated 30.11.2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Junagadh in Criminal Appeal No.110 of 2012, the sentence imposed by judgment and order dated 20.12.2012 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Visavadar in Criminal Case No.58 of 2008 as well as the judgment and order dated 30.11.2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Junagadh in Criminal Appeal No.110 of 2012 is hereby suspended pending hearing and final disposal of the Criminal Revision Application.
